UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Player profile storing account callsign, mascot companion, overall gamification progression, and per-mode win/loss and personal best statistics.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

tagline.description: Player studio bio or status tagline.

xp.description: Total cumulative XP across all game modes.

coins.description: Available studio coins for in-game power-ups.

overallScore.description: Cumulative points scored across all sessions.

bestSetScore.description: Personal best single-set score across any mode.

totalWins.description: Total correct guesses across all game modes.

totalLosses.description: Total incorrect guesses across all game modes.

totalGamesPlayed.description: Total completed sets across all game modes.

fastestSnippetGuessed.description: Shortest audio snippet duration guessed correctly in seconds.

unlockedBadges.description: Bounded list of unlocked achievement badge IDs (max 20).

trackWins.description: Correct guesses in Track ID mode.

trackLosses.description: Incorrect guesses in Track ID mode.

trackGames.description: Completed sets in Track ID mode.

trackBestScore.description: Personal best set score in Track ID mode.

trackBestStreak.description: Personal best streak in Track ID mode.

artistBestScore.description: Personal best set score in Artist mode.

artistBestStreak.description: Personal best streak in Artist mode.

genreBestScore.description: Personal best set score in Genre mode.

genreBestStreak.description: Personal best streak in Genre mode.

yearWins.description: Correct guesses in Release Year mode.

yearLosses.description: Incorrect guesses in Release Year mode.

yearGames.description: Completed sets in Release Year mode.

yearBestScore.description: Personal best set score in Release Year mode.

yearBestStreak.description: Personal best streak in Release Year mode.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated player profile, mode-specific win/loss statistics, personal bests, and gamification state for each authenticated user.
